svg.title: Goods fulfillment and customer billing
svg.desc: Goods fulfillment and customer billing. Which line-level keys connect ordered, shipped, and billed quantities? Primary tables: Shipment, ShipmentLine, SalesInvoice, SalesInvoiceLine. ShipmentLineID is optional on customer invoice lines because services use ServiceBillingLine. This view focuses on the goods path; an order is non-posting.

div.div:
(PK) = primary key. (FK) = foreign key.
Solid crow’s-foot lines show foreign-key relationships; dashed labeled lines show conditional traces or analytical matches. See r1, r2… in the relationship table.

a.text: Text is not SVG - cannot display
